name: Cylindrical Brush Pot with Decoration of a Fisherman in a Small Boat within a Mountainous Landscape
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；19th century；Porcelain with molded and incised elements, decoration painted in underglaze cobalt blue and copper red, and localized areas articulated with celadon glaze; with spurious underglaze cobalt blue mark reading "Xuande nian zhi" within a circular recess on the base
